tip.zh:
🏠 今日北京大雾转晴，气温约 4~16°C，午间已回暖（实况约 15°C）；无降水，但阵风很强（模型日最大阵风约 44 km/h），且空气综合指数仍危险级（US AQI≈267），出门注意防风、戴口罩，雾霾敏感尽量缩短户外暴露。
🏃 训练提醒：今天周四是可选跑日——与「强阵风 + 危险级空气」明显冲突，建议改室内跑或改到周五再评估；若执意外跑，务必缩短里程、避开开阔风口，并戴口罩。周五早上健身：约 3~12°C、阵风仍偏强（约 22 km/h），去健身房途中注意防风保暖。周六起有雨雪降温（约 1~6°C、降水约 12mm），周日仍可能雨雪偏冷。
📅 未来7天（北京，Open-Meteo；阴晴参考模型 weather_code，空气 Open-Meteo AQ）：
• 11/5 周四 4~16°C 大雾转晴，阵风很强（可选跑慎户外；空气危险级）
• 11/6 周五 3~12°C 晴到少云，阵风偏强（晨练防风保暖）
• 11/7 周六 1~6°C 雨雪可能（降水约 12mm）
• 11/8 周日 0~8°C 雨雪可能（降水约 6mm，偏冷）
• 11/9 周一 -1~9°C 晴
• 11/10 周二 -1~9°C 晴
• 11/11 周三 0~10°C 晴
• 11/12 周四 1~12°C 晴
（气温/降水/风：Open-Meteo 约 11:45 北京时间；空气：Open-Meteo Air Quality）
tip.en:
🏠 Beijing today: fog clearing to sunny, ~4–16°C, milder midday (~15°C); dry but very strong gusts (~44 km/h) and hazardous composite air (US AQI≈267)—windproof + mask; minimize outdoor exposure if sensitive.
🏃 Training: Thu is the optional-run day—conflicts with strong gusts + hazardous air; prefer indoor or wait for Fri. Fri morning gym: cooler (~3–12°C) with still-gusty wind (~22 km/h)—dress windproof. Sat onward: rain/snow cooldown (~1–6°C, ~12mm), Sun still chilly with more precip risk.
📅 Next 7 days (Beijing, Open-Meteo):
• Thu 11/5 4–16°C fog→clear, very strong gusts (caution for optional run; hazardous air)
• Fri 11/6 3–12°C mainly clear, gusty

openingSummary.zh: 过去约两日，图像生成与 Claude 科学生物学同台：OpenAI 发布 ChatGPT Images 2.6（GIF、参考图；API 侧 GPT-Image-2.6 Flare / Sunburst，宣称约 50% 更快）。Anthropic 用 Claude 协助首次解析细菌/噬菌体来源 Vault 颗粒 3D 结构，并开源 FlashProve 可验证推理。Codex/ChatGPT 产品侧 @thsottiaux 欢迎 Cat（前 Claude Code 产品负责人）与 Pierre 团队入列，并预告网络安全团队进展。Andrew Ng 预热 AI Dev NYC（11/30–12/1）。缺口：@karpathy / @claudeai / Meta 近 48h 无高信号原创帖；DeepMind 仅 RT 语音 remix；无 DeepSeek 一手 X。
openingSummary.en: Over ~48h, image gen and Claude biology led: OpenAI shipped ChatGPT Images 2.6 (GIFs, reference images; API GPT-Image-2.6 Flare/Sunburst, ~50% faster claimed). Anthropic used Claude to map the first bacterial/phage vault-particle 3D structure, alongside open-source FlashProve. Codex/ChatGPT voice @thsottiaux welcomed Cat (ex Claude Code PM) and Pierre, teasing cyber-team work. Andrew Ng plugged AI Dev NYC (Nov 30–Dec 1). Gaps: @karpathy / @claudeai / Meta quiet on high-signal originals; DeepMind only RT’d voice remix; no DeepSeek primary X.

summary.zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Images 2.6：支持 GIF 与参考图；API 新增 GPT-Image-2.6 Flare（最快约 6 秒）与 Sunburst（更高质量/编辑一致性），宣称图像生成约快 50%；全订阅档 ChatGPT/Codex 今日可用。
summary.en: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Images 2.6—GIFs + reference images; API adds GPT-Image-2.6 Flare (~6s) and Sunburst (higher quality/edit consistency), claiming ~50% faster image gen; live today across ChatGPT/Codex tiers.

caption.zh: OpenAI Images 2.6 发布视频封面（来源：@OpenAI）
GPT-Image-2.6 Flare / Sunburst 配图（来源：@OpenAI）
参考图复用功能配图（来源：@OpenAI）

summary.zh: Anthropic：生物学团队与 Claude 合作，首次解析细菌/噬菌体来源 Vault（穹窿）颗粒 3D 结构；传统纯化约 3 天被压缩到约 90 分钟量级，并讨论 AI 加速科学中的失误与协作。
summary.en: Anthropic: biology team with Claude mapped the first 3D vault particle from bacterial/phage life; purification that used to take ~3 days was cut toward ~90 minutes, with notes on AI mistakes and collaboration.

caption.zh: Vault 研究预印本卡片（来源：@AnthropicAI）

summary.zh: ChatGPT/Codex 产品侧：欢迎 Cat 加入共建，并称已组建世界级网络安全团队，后续几周将分享更多进展。
summary.en: Codex/ChatGPT product voice: welcomed Cat aboard and said a world-class cyber team is assembled, with more to share in coming weeks.

summary.zh: Andrew Ng：预热 AI Dev（纽约，11/30–12/1），称 LinkedIn 研究显示 AI Engineer 已成七大经济体增长最快岗位之一。
summary.en: Andrew Ng plugged AI Dev in NYC (Nov 30–Dec 1), citing LinkedIn that AI Engineer is among the 10 fastest-growing occupations across seven major economies.

summary.zh: OpenAIDevs：Images 2.6 API 可用图像标注精确指定编辑位置；低复杂度下 Flare 最快约 6 秒；Codex 图像编辑改为覆盖层内直接改。
summary.en: OpenAIDevs: Images 2.6 API supports marked-up image edits; Flare can hit ~6s at low complexity; Codex image edits now happen in-overlay instead of a side panel.

title.zh: Introducing Images 2.6：更快生成与更可控的编辑轮次

summary.zh: 11/4：ChatGPT/Codex/API 上线 Images 2.6——GIF、参考图、图像标注与 SVG（API）；Flare/Sunburst 两档模型；全订阅档全球可用。
summary.en: Nov 4: Images 2.6 on ChatGPT/Codex/API—GIFs, reference images, markup, SVG (API); Flare/Sunburst models; available globally across tiers.

title.zh: 与 Claude 一起探究 Vault 颗粒：首个细菌生命来源 3D 结构

summary.zh: 11/4：生命科学团队用 Claude 在约 150 亿预测蛋白中检索 MVP 同源物，完成 DNA 构建与冷冻电镜分析；重点解析噬菌体 L05（约 96 亚基），并讨论 AI 加速与失误。
summary.en: Nov 4: life-sciences team used Claude to search ~15B predicted proteins for MVP homologs, design constructs, and analyze cryo-EM—highlighting phage L05 (~96 subunits) plus AI speedups and mistakes.

title.zh: FlashProve：大模型可验证推理取得进展
title.en: Progress on provable inference for large language models

summary.zh: 11/3：开源 FlashProve（zkSNARK 路线）让提供方提交权重承诺并为回复生成可验证证明；用于降低对话劫持风险与核对评测模型=线上模型。
summary.en: Nov 3: open-source FlashProve (zkSNARK-style) lets providers commit to weights and prove responses—aimed at chat hijacks and verifying the served model matches evaluations.

alphaxivTop3.title: Stabilizing On-Policy Targeted Guidance in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
alphaxivTop3.authors: Kevin Frans, Alexander M Rush, Sergey Levine, Pieter Abbeel (Cursor / UC Berkeley)

summary.zh: （Agent 优先）alphaXiv Hot #2（约 11/3）：面向多轮软件工程智能体的 targeted guidance——在失败回合插入文本提示，用 on-policy self-distillation 学难优化行为，同时尽量不伤基线 coding pass（作者自报）。
summary.en: (Agent pick) alphaXiv Hot #2 (~Nov 3): targeted guidance for multi-turn SWE agents—inject textual hints on failing turns via on-policy self-distillation to learn hard behaviors without degrading baseline coding pass (author-reported).

alphaxivTop3.title: Adversarial Speculative Reasoning Improves Long Horizon Agents
alphaxivTop3.authors: Hongyin Luo, Wei Fang, Dana Wensberg, Jack O'Brien, et al.

summary.zh: （Agent 优先）Hot 前列（约 11/3）：把 speculative decoding 从纯加速改成「上下文精度分配器」——训练 draft 在关键决策点被拒绝，使关键推理落在噪声最低的验证槽；作者报告长程 coding agent 成功率提升且不改 target（作者自报）。
summary.en: (Agent pick) trending (~Nov 3): recasts speculative decoding as a context-precision allocator—train the draft to be rejected at critical decisions so key tokens are written at the least-noisy verify slot; reported long-horizon coding-agent gains without changing the target (author-reported).

alphaxivTop3.title: You don't need long context
alphaxivTop3.authors: Yonggan Fu, Wonmin Byeon, Siru Ouyang, Pavlo Molchanov, et al. (NVIDIA)

summary.zh: （Agent 优先）Hot #8（约 11/3）：主张频繁 compaction / 单步交接即可在长程任务上保住准确率；作者报告 16K vs 256K 配置下解码吞吐可高约 7×，并引出 SSSM 概念（作者自报，待独立复核）。
summary.en: (Agent pick) Hot #8 (~Nov 3): argues frequent compaction / single-action handoffs preserve long-horizon accuracy; reports ~7× decode throughput at 16K vs 256K context configs and sketches SSSMs (author-reported).

summary.en: Latest stable still v0.22.7 (2026-11-03): patch rolling up ~174 PRs since v0.22.6 (CLI/installers, Microsoft Store, Docker, Hermes Cloud); full curated notes with v0.23.0. No newer tag observed today.

summary.en: New prerelease v2026.11.5-beta.1 (2026-11-04): Knowledge Scribes, PostgreSQL data plane, Control UI nav overhaul, PR-from-chat workflows, expanded cross-device/cloud execution. Stable remains v2026.10.10 (Nov 3).

summary.en: No new model/plan launch in ~48h. Product-adjacent: vault biology write-up (Nov 4) and FlashProve (Nov 3); newsroom Latest date bar shows Nov 5 but featured remains prior announcements. @claudeai quiet on originals. Peripheral Fable 5.5 chatter not officially confirmed—omitted.
